title: General Training Mock Test 1
description: A full General Training test. Listening: renting a flat, a volunteer orientation, a tutorial on a community energy presentation, and a lecture on the psychology of habits. Reading: evening course adverts and a pool notice, workplace leave and first aid information, and a feature on Europe's night trains. Writing: a formal letter about a bag left on a coach and an essay on falling volunteer numbers. Speaking: neighbourhoods, helping a stranger, and community life.
